thesis: The bull establishes a positive business-growth thesis, but the bear carries the narrower decision about a new purchase now. Strong growth and cash generation do not resolve the missing same-share-basis purchase valuation, and the technical report supplies no confirmed reversal. Preserve TSM as a priority candidate while withholding an immediate add signal.
strongest_counterexample: Comparable Q3 revenue grew 50.95%, net income grew 68.71%, official margins remain strong and Q3 free cash flow was NT$476.56bn. Deferring entry can miss further gains if the business growth is sustained and the current correction reverses before the missing valuation bridge is resolved.
invalidation_conditions: Reopen the entry ruling if the ADR/ordinary-share valuation bridge is reconciled and observed close exceeds both SMA20 and SMA50 with MACD histogram above zero; this removes the stated information/timing objections rather than guaranteeing a buy.
The favorable business-growth premise weakens if reported Q4 revenue falls below management guidance lower bound US$52.3bn.
evidence_gaps: Verified same-share-basis trailing earnings/ADR valuation bridge.
Independent dated headlines and an ingested typed macro snapshot.
decisive_factors: Strong comparable growth and cash generation support business quality.
Provider EPS basis is undeclared and differs from ordinary-share/ADR presentations.
Price below SMA20/SMA50 and MACD histogram -3.8703 do not confirm an oversold rebound.
